$comment: PLAN-D (feedback wave 2026-09-17, Derek's decision 2) — hands-free pause and resume by voice. The ONE shared contract for both clients: the command grammar, the acceptance and near-miss vectors, the five spoken strings and the resume tone's parameters. Canonical copy lives here; iOS carries byte-identical copies (app bundle + test fixtures), pinned by scripts/check-voice-pause-fixture-sync.sh as a CertMateUnified/deploy-testflight.sh preflight. Tests assert against the keys in this file, never against literals.

grammar.$comment: Whole-utterance match, case-insensitive, punctuation-stripped, anchored after an optional prefix, with nothing else in the utterance. The brand word is required. No fuzzy matching (the 2026-06-24 hard rule). Normalisation runs in the order listed; the pattern is then matched against the normalised text.
normalisation: replace every character outside [a-z0-9] with a space
collapse runs of whitespace to one space and trim
grammar.pattern: ^(?:(?:hey|okay|ok) )?(?:certmate|cert mate|sert mate) (?<command>pause|pause listening|hold on|carry on|resume|im back|listen)$

near_miss.text: certmate carry on, circuit two now
CertMate, carry on with the ring test.

strings.$comment: Decision 10 (TAKEN 2026-09-20) pins the first four; Decision 24(c) (TAKEN 2026-09-21) approves resume_line and retires resume_ack FOR THE VOICE-PAUSE ROUTE ONLY (a per-entry flag, not a deletion, so its bytes stay pinned). A test that enumerates what the voice-pause route PRODUCES reads each entry's status and finds four. Every string is also a must-not-command vector.

pause_ack.text: Paused. Say 'CertMate, carry on' when you're ready.

resume_ack.decision: WAVE-CONTEXT.md Decision 10 (TAKEN 2026-09-20), string 2; retired for the voice-pause route by Decision 24(c) (TAKEN 2026-09-21)

reminder.text: Still paused. Say 'CertMate, carry on' to resume.

still_paused_cue.text: Still paused — say 'CertMate, carry on' on its own to resume.

resume_line.text: Carrying on — anything said while paused wasn't recorded.

resume_tone.$comment: Pinned by PARAMETERS, not bytes: web synthesises from oscillators at the AudioContext rate and iOS renders 22.05 kHz PCM into a WAV, so the two cannot be byte-identical and no test may claim they are. Each client asserts its own constants against this object. Envelope per note: linear attack from 0 to peak_amplitude over attack_ms, then exponential decay from peak_amplitude to decay_floor_gain at the note's end.
